name: deposit_record
description: Record a security or retainer deposit received from a client, in minor units, with its currency, the date it arrived and the bank reference. Returns the DEP-YYYY-NNNN id.

arguments.name: client
arguments.desc: Client name or client id. A name the invoice server already knows brings its address, email and VAT id onto the deposit

arguments.name: amount_minor
arguments.desc: What was received, in MINOR units: 50000 = 500.00 EUR, 50000 = JPY 50000. Never a decimal

arguments.name: kind
arguments.desc: security: held against damage or non-payment. retainer: held against work not yet invoiced

arguments.name: currency
arguments.desc: Defaults to your business default currency

arguments.name: received_date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the money arrived. Defaults to today

arguments.name: reference
arguments.desc: Bank reference, transfer note or cheque number the money arrived with

arguments.name: notes
arguments.desc: Free text kept on the record and printed on the statement

arguments.name: client_email
arguments.desc: Only if the user gave it; otherwise the stored client's email is used

arguments.name: client_address
arguments.desc: Postal address for the statement's client block, newlines allowed

arguments.name: client_vat_id
arguments.desc: Client VAT / tax registration id

name: deposit_list
description: List deposits with what was received, applied, refunded and still held on each. Filter by client, by status held, applied or refunded, by kind and by received date range.

arguments.name: client
arguments.desc: Only deposits for this client id, exact name, or a name containing this text

arguments.name: status
arguments.desc: Default "all". held means some of the money is still held

arguments.name: kind
arguments.desc: Default "all"

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, earliest received date

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, latest received date

name: deposit_apply
description: Apply part or all of a held deposit to one invoice: records that amount as a payment on the invoice through the invoice engine. Refuses more than is held or more than the invoice still owes.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Deposit id such as DEP-2026-0001, or an exact client name

arguments.name: invoice
arguments.desc: The invoice number to apply it to, e.g. INV-2026-0001

arguments.name: amount_minor
arguments.desc: How much of the deposit to apply, in minor units. Defaults to the smaller of what is held and what the invoice still owes

arguments.name: date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the deposit was set against the invoice. Defaults to today

arguments.name: note
arguments.desc: Free text kept on the application row

name: deposit_refund
description: Give part or all of a held deposit back to the client, with the date and how it was sent. Refuses more than is still held. The invoice server is not touched: a refund is not a payment.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Deposit id such as DEP-2026-0001, or an exact client name

arguments.name: amount_minor
arguments.desc: How much to give back, in minor units. Defaults to everything still held

arguments.name: date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the money went back. Defaults to today

arguments.name: method
arguments.desc: How it was sent, e.g. "bank transfer to the account it came from". Printed on the statement

arguments.name: note
arguments.desc: Free text kept on the refund row

name: deposit_balance
description: Answer "how much of theirs am I holding?" for one client or for everyone: received, applied to invoices, refunded and still held, one row per currency, never added across currencies.

arguments.name: client
arguments.desc: Client id, exact name or a name containing this text. Leave out for every client

arguments.name: as_of
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, count only deposits received on or before this day

name: deposit_statement_text
description: Turn one client's deposits into a plain-text statement with every movement in date order and the closing balance, ready to paste into an email. Free on every tier.

arguments.name: client
arguments.desc: Client id, exact name or a name containing this text

arguments.name: currency
arguments.desc: Only needed when the client has deposits in more than one currency

arguments.name: as_of
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD printed as the statement date. Defaults to today

arguments.name: greeting
arguments.desc: Opening line, default "Hello" plus the client name

arguments.name: sign_off
arguments.desc: Closing line, default your business name from the shared profile

name: deposit_statement_pdf
description: Call this tool to write one client's A4 deposit statement and return the file path. Titled DEPOSIT STATEMENT, every movement in date order, closing with what is still held. Pro.

arguments.name: client
arguments.desc: Client id, exact name or a name containing this text

arguments.name: currency
arguments.desc: Only needed when the client has deposits in more than one currency

arguments.name: as_of
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD printed as the statement date. Defaults to today

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the PDF; defaults to the deposits data directory under pdf/. Use a .pdf path: the bytes written are always PDF

name: deposits_report
description: What is held per currency, the oldest held deposits, and every deposit received more than N days ago with none of it applied to an invoice. Pro.

arguments.name: older_than_days
arguments.desc: Flag deposits received this many days ago or more with nothing applied. Default 90

arguments.name: as_of
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD to count from. Defaults to today

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: How many oldest held deposits to list. Default 10

name: license_status
description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

name: license_activate
description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: License key from the checkout confirmation page
